# Index

## Concepts

- [[rogue-tag]] — Carries a tag that is not in the taxonomy.
- [[backwards-dates]] — Carries a created date after its updated date.
- [[broken-target]] — Carries a wikilink that resolves to nothing.
- [[orphan-page]] — No page in the vault links to this one.
- [[no-provenance]] — Cites a source without a provenance marker.
- [[missing-raw]] — Cites a raw source that was never ingested.
- [[drift-cite]] — Cites a raw source whose hash has drifted.
- [[long-page]] — Exceeds 200 lines.
- [[KV_Cache]] — Filename violates the naming convention.
- [[nonexistent-catalog-entry]] — This page does not exist in the vault.
